_note: Model registry: every callable model + its economics. Prices are USD per 1M tokens, taken from the vendors' LIVE July 2026 pricing pages (Anthropic/OpenAI/Google), NOT guessed. ADDING A MODEL IS ONE ENTRY (id must be fully qualified provider/id). Keep prices current. local=true means unmetered (Ollama). available=false hides a model from routing without deleting it. Override at ~/.local/share/pi-stack/routing/models.json.

models.label: Claude Fable 5
models.notes: Frontier / top of BenchLM overall (SWE-bench Verified ~95%). The 'even Opus falls short' tier: one genuinely hard problem, no cost ceiling.

models.label: Claude Opus 4.8
models.notes: Accuracy-critical work where instruction-following precision reduces rework: architecture, product strategy (SWE-bench Pro 69.2, HLE 57.9).

models.label: Claude Sonnet 5
models.notes: The production workhorse (Anthropic's own guidance: send most coding + knowledge work here). SWE-bench Pro 63.2, near-Opus at lower cost. $2/$10 intro through 2026-08-31, then $3/$15.

models.label: Claude Haiku 4.5
models.notes: Cheap Anthropic tier: classification, routing, extraction, cheap QA where accuracy still matters a little.

models.label: GPT-5.6 Sol
models.notes: OpenAI flagship (#3 overall on BenchLM). The cross-vendor adversarial reviewer of Claude-authored work: different blind spots.

models.label: GPT-5.6 Terra
models.notes: OpenAI mid-tier (production default equivalent). A cheaper cross-vendor option.

models.label: Gemini 3.1 Pro
models.notes: Google frontier + reasoning leader (GPQA ~94.1%), 1M+ context, cheapest of the frontier tier. A THIRD independent vendor for red-team/security.

models.label: Gemini 3.5 Flash
models.notes: Google price-performance middle. Fast cross-vendor option for cheaper reasoning/search.

models.label: Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite
models.notes: The volume floor (cheapest of any major vendor). High-volume breadth fan-out + parallel reads.

models.label: Qwen 3.5 9B (local)
models.notes: Local via Ollama. The best all-rounder that fits a 16GB machine (~6.6GB download, Apache 2.0, tools + thinking; current as of 2026-02). Free + private but slower than cloud, so it wins nothing by default and is an offline/private fallback. Bigger boxes can bump to gemma4:e4b (~9GB) or qwen3.5:27b. Needs `ollama pull qwen3.5:9b` + the ollama-bridge to expose it. NOTE: this is the ROUTER's local option; the memory watcher is a separate role but defaults to the same qwen3.5:9b so Ollama keeps one model resident for both.
